propositions: A crash after retired tombstone replacement but before live replacement leaves the same exact identity in both live and retired states; recovery must detect and safely complete this partial state at the validated write boundary.
Retirement completion must read only local binding state before any remote issue observation, requiring invocation after the under-lock staleness gate but before the first remote fetch.
Tombstone identity, forward entry identity, and reverse entry identity must match exactly for completion to proceed; any mismatch or corruption triggers a typed safety abort without mutation.

A durable tombstone is the authoritative retirement intent; later automatic confirms (200 response, clear_absent, same-key bind_confirm) do not override it; only explicit unretire removes the tombstone.
The rich-text handler must use the narrow facade operation instead of mutating entries obtained from all_bindings().
Construction, load, reconcile-check, dry-run, preview, selection, and filtered operations perform zero writes during retirement completion; pre-existing create-recovery gate behavior is unchanged.
